scenario: Same Smoke owner: product E2B Cloud A to an independent normally paired GitHub Actions local device B

findings.detail: New ordinary dispatch resolves GitHub owner/repo or URL against the owner's current GitHub user-token and Mikka App repository intersection. Public GitHub repositories have no anonymous exception.
A non-GitHub remote can be parsed but does not receive the writable GitHub repositoryAdmission required by the Cloud-to-local recovery path.
The ordinary RFC 8628 device authorization and normal registration paths can bind an independent runner to its approving owner. They cannot supply missing GitHub repository authorization.

The existing local acceptance driver rejects CI and assumes an expendable account when revoking device tokens. A later production runner would require its own bounded driver and exact newly created device/token cleanup, without removing CI guards.

missingBeforeAnyExecution: Normal owner evidence of an already authorized exact GitHub repository; no new GitHub/OAuth grant or share is authorized for this substitute.
permittedFutureEvidenceBoundary: Only after normal owner GET confirms a newly authorized task, current epoch and run may an already reviewed single-task READ ONLY diagnostic inspect the host recovery grant/checkpoint/machine binding. No SQL mutation can create acceptance state.
interpretation: This is a source-backed feasibility assessment using an existing historical inventory, not a failed paid run or a current production authorization query. Keep the real Cloud/device acceptance item open.
